messages.subject: observation matrix in Besag model
parts:
Hello all,

I have a problem implementing my hierrarchical model. My observations y are linked to the latent variables  with y=Ax where A is of dimension (space observations X time observations ) X (latent variables). The prior which i am using is a GMRF for the latent variables with a Gamma distribution for the smoothness hyperparameter. I found out that the besag model is doing exactly this job, but I have no idea how to implement the observation matrix for this model. Is there any solution for this or do I have to change the model?

Kind regards, Jacopo

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] observation matrix in Besag model
parts:
There is an argument doing exactly this

control.matrix$A

see ?control.matrix

I attach some example programs that do this
